name: stress-ng memcpy
description: Start N workers that copies data to and from a buffer using memcpy and then move the data in the buffer with memmove with 3 different alignments. This will exercise the data cache and memory copying. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
